annotation.title_clean: Proyecto de Ley sobre Regulación y Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill of Law on the Regulation and Use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Diputada Nacional Anahí Costa, Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
annotation.venue: Cámara de Diputados de la Nación Argentina
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine bill introduced by Deputy Anahí Costa to regulate AI use nationally. It sets UNESCO-derived guiding principles, bans harmful and military uses, creates an executive-designated oversight body with impact assessments, audits, a provider registry and sanctions. It does not address robots specifically.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nine guiding principles drawn from UNESCO Recommendation (proportionality, safety, fairness, human oversight, transparency, accountability)
Prohibits AI that harms rights, replaces human accountability, manipulates information, or has military/warlike use
Executive-designated enforcement body may require impact assessment or audit
Registry of AI developers, providers and responsible parties
